newsitem.title: USA: CPI Corp Q4 continuing operations EPS up.
newsitem.headline: CPI Corp Q4 continuing operations EPS up.

text.p: CPI Corp said earnings from continuing operations in the fourth quarter rose to $1.03 a share, on 15.3 percent fewer weighted average shares outstanding, compared with $0.88 in the 1995 quarter.

Earnings from continuing operations of $12.3 million in the fourth quarter were "essentially flat" with a year ago. The exact earnings from continuing operations in the year-ago period were not immediately available.

Including year-ago discontinued operations, net income for the 1996 fourth quarter, ended February 1, 1997, was $12.3 million or $1.03 a share, compared with year-ago net income of $9.6 million or $0.69 a share.

For fiscal 1996, earnings from continuing operations were $14.4 million or $1.06 a share, down from $17.6 million or $1.26 a share in fiscal 1995. The 1996 results included a gain, net of taxes of $3.9 million or $0.29 a share from the sale of its interest in Fox Photo. Fiscal 1995 net earnings, including a loss from discontinued operations of $3,326,000 or $0.24 a share, were $14.3 million or $1.02 a share.
The net earnings and earnings from continuing operations were the same in 1996.
Total net sales for fiscal 1996 were $467.0 million, down from $526.7 million, due to the sale of a 51 percent interest in Fox Photo Inc photo finishing operation.
Weighted average shares outstanding for fiscal 1996 were $13.5 million, compared with 14.0 million in 1995. The company said it repurchased 2.25 million shares in November 1996.

CPI said portrait studio sales for the full year increased to $289.8 million compared with $279.6 million a year ago. But operating earnings for the year declined to $35.7 million from $42.6 million because of higher operating expenses.
The wall decor segment's sales for the year rose 6.7 percent to $62.7 million, compared with $58.7 million, with growth mainly due to 12 new stores opened during the year.
